## Problem

Automating scientific workflows requires systems that can plan experiments, interpret results, and adapt strategies based on outcomes. Traditional scripting is too rigid for exploratory research.

## Approach

I am building agentic AI systems that combine reinforcement learning with large language models to automate laboratory tasks. The system plans multi-step experiments, executes protocols on robotic platforms, recovers from instrument faults, and iteratively refines strategies based on outcomes. Development and evaluation use the [PCL simulator (CloudBench)](pcl_simulation.qmd) before deployment on physical hardware.

## Status

Work in progress. Related contributed talk at the [AI Scientist Summer Workshop](https://ai-scientist-workshop.github.io/#about) (Microsoft Research, 2026).
